posts.title: Room 300
posts.description: I tried to see this room; to visualize it, as they say now; an open ceiling, an ichor-stained rock on the floor gleaming by moonlight… Yet, how to go back to such a place, after all I’ve been through: how many sacrifices did unfold? Tell me, René, you mimic, you doppelgänger… (No shadow under the rock, no)
